title: Why Harry and Meghan were caught off guard by King Charles’ latest letter
summary_full: King Charles III has clarified Prince Harry and Meghan's status as private citizens.  The royal family confirmed they remain non-working members, which was previously agreed.  This clarification came shortly before a letter was sent to senior officials.  Harry and Meghan continue their commercial and charitable work in their private capacity.  Their security arrangements remain a separate and ongoing discussion.
